title: Aromatic Crisp Ukrainian Chicken Skewers
description: Pungent and crisp Ukrainian dish featuring marjoram, perfect for kids and adults alike, this egg-free friendly recipe is a delight to make and eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, marjoram, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy!
